evidence: The XRD analysis results indicate polycrystalline nature of the TiN films with a (1 1 1) preferred orientation. The XPS and AES analysis results establish that the Cl impurity concentration in the TiN films is lower than 1 at.%. Atomic force microscopy (AFM) analysis [Topometrix–Accurex II] was performed in the 2 mm range for the investigation of the film morphology and the surface roughness. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis was performed at 15 kV to investigate step coverage.
